government.pm: Jacinda Ardern (to 25 Jan 2023), then Chris Hipkins
government.name: Sixth Labour Government (second term)
government.notes: Labour won 65 of 120 seats, the first single-party majority under MMP. It nonetheless signed a 'cooperation agreement' with the Greens (31 Oct 2020) under which Green co-leaders James Shaw and Marama Davidson became ministers outside Cabinet; the Greens agreed to abstain (not oppose) on confidence and supply votes. Sworn in 6 Nov 2020. Ardern resigned in Jan 2023; Chris Hipkins became PM on 25 Jan 2023. Election held with the cannabis and End of Life Choice referendums; it was delayed from 19 Sep to 17 Oct because of COVID-19.

notes: Electorate majorities/runners-up are taken from the official-count vote tables in each electorate's Wikipedia article (which cite the Electoral Commission's official results pages); where the summary table, the article's majority box and the candidate vote counts disagree, the value two of them agree on is used – see 'majority_corrections'.

Cross-check: national party-vote totals vs the sum of per-electorate official party votes in the electorate articles – largest gap +1181 votes (opportunity, 0.04% of valid votes); gaps are attributed to transcription errors in individual electorate articles, and the national (Electoral Commission summary) figures are used.
